title: Ollie, a privacy-focused AI assistant, is shutting down
hook_text: Ollie AI is shutting down in seven days.
script:
Ollie is shutting down in seven days due to an overcrowded market.
The privacy-focused assistant built its reputation on respecting user confidentiality.
An increasing flood of competing models made it impossible for the small platform to survive.
Users now have just one week to export their stored chat histories before servers go dark.
Can any privacy-first AI survive against dominant market leaders?
